description.zh:
剧本ID。
>调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~3000306~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
Playbook ID.
> You can obtain this parameter by calling the [DescribePlaybooks](~~2627461~~) interface.

description.zh:
创建策略任务时传入的漏洞ID。
>调用[DescribeVulList](~~DescribeVulList~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The vulnerability ID passed when creating the policy task.
> You can obtain this parameter by calling the [DescribeVulList](~~DescribeVulList~~) interface.

description.zh:
剧本任务执行的UUID。
>调用[DescribeSoarRecords](~~2627455~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
UUID of the playbook task execution.
> You can obtain this parameter by calling the [DescribeSoarRecords](~~2627455~~) interface.

descriptions.zh: 仅云安全中心的企业版和旗舰版支持该API调用，其他版本不支持。
descriptions.en: This API is only supported by the Enterprise and Flagship editions of Cloud Security Center, other versions do not support it.
